import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        if (b == 0)
            return a;
        return gcd(b, a % b);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int a = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int x = 0, y = 0;
        double dif = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        for (long j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            for (long i = (j * a) / b - 1; i <= (j * a) / b + 1; i++) {
                if (Math.abs((double) i / j - (double) a / b) < dif) {
                    dif = Math.abs((double) i / j - (double) a / b);
                    x = (int) i;
                    y = (int) j;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println((x / gcd(x, y)) + "/" + (y / gcd(x, y)));
    }
}
